skill.name: docs-review
skill.description: Review Metabase documentation changes against the project writing style guide for tone, structure, formatting, links, and examples.
skill.summary: Checks documentation diffs against Metabase style rules and returns numbered, actionable review feedback.
skill.author: metabase

content.value_statement: Documentation reviews can miss tone, clarity, and formatting problems in fast pull requests. This skill checks Metabase docs changes and returns numbered, actionable feedback.
actual_capabilities: Reviews Markdown documentation changes for Metabase writing style rules.
Checks tone, clarity, headings, links, formatting, and examples.
Returns sequentially numbered issues with suggested fixes.
Supports local review output when GitHub review tools are unavailable.
Can use GitHub pending review tools to post PR comments when available.
limitations: It is tailored to Metabase documentation standards.
It depends on visible diffs, files, or review context.
It does not verify product behavior outside provided evidence.
GitHub comment posting requires the matching MCP review tools.

use_cases.title: Review docs pull requests
use_cases.description: Check incoming docs changes for Metabase tone, structure, and style before publication.

use_cases.title: Check product docs updates
use_cases.description: Review documentation changes attached to product work before requesting a technical writing review.

use_cases.title: Audit local drafts
use_cases.description: Review a local Markdown draft for headings, links, examples, and reader-focused clarity.

prompt_templates.title: Review one document
prompt_templates.scenario: First review of a single docs file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Markdown file against the Metabase documentation style guide. List only material issues and number each issue.

prompt_templates.title: Review a docs diff
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review of changed documentation lines.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this documentation diff for tone, structure, links, formatting, and examples. Return numbered issues with suggested fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Compare before and after
prompt_templates.scenario: Review a rewrite for regressions and missing context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these before and after docs changes. Identify reader-impact problems, missing context, and style guide violations.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare PR comments
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced pull request review with GitHub tools.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the GitHub pending review workflow if available. Review all documentation changes, then post one numbered comment per material issue.

output_examples.input: A pull request changes setup instructions and adds several headings.
output_examples.output: The review returns two numbered issues: one for a vague heading, and one for formal wording that should be conversational.

output_examples.input: A Markdown draft includes many links labeled here and several broad screenshots.
output_examples.output: The review flags descriptive link text and recommends scoped visuals that focus on the relevant interface.

output_examples.input: A docs diff contains no material style or clarity problems.
output_examples.output: The review reports that no issues are worth raising, instead of creating low-value comments.

best_practices: Provide the full diff or exact Markdown files to reduce missed context.
Ask for material reader-impact issues rather than copy edits only.
Review final comments before posting them to a public pull request.
anti_patterns: Using it as a general grammar checker without Metabase context.
Asking it to approve docs without reading the changed lines.
Treating every style preference as a blocking release issue.

faq.question: Does this skill edit files automatically?
faq.answer: No. It reviews docs and suggests fixes unless another workflow applies changes.

faq.question: Can it review pull requests?
faq.answer: Yes. When GitHub MCP review tools are available, it can prepare pending review comments.

faq.question: What documents work best?
faq.answer: Markdown docs, pull request diffs, and focused documentation files work best.

faq.question: Does it only apply to Metabase?
faq.answer: It is tuned for Metabase style, but its review structure can help similar docs.

faq.question: Can it verify code examples?
faq.answer: It can flag examples that look broken, but it cannot prove behavior without running or inspecting context.

faq.question: Will it request changes on a PR?
faq.answer: The skill instructs non-blocking comment reviews, not request changes.
